entries.message: This update includes improve sync restore and media integrations and make restore issues repairable and episode sync safe.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Makes watch-history restore authoritative, target-aware, and safer while surfacing actionable sync attention details.
Adds watchlist and up-next synchronization across connected media services with matching documentation and coverage.
Treats expected unavailable-library items as non-blocking restore skips while retaining real failures for repair or retry.
Repair blocked restore items per destination or show without releasing the restore fence prematurely
Add Fix Match recovery for restore failures with missing saved identities
Commit manual unwatches during restores and queue outbound unplayed propagation for later
Canonicalize split and combined episode numbering from titles and season metadata before Trakt dispatch
Keep Up Next artwork on cached local posters and authenticated provider fallbacks
Improve grouped Sync Activity controls, inline detail routing, and retry visibility
messageFragments: Feature - Improve sync restore and media integrations
Feature - Make restore issues repairable and episode sync safe
